# RE.cipe

> A terminal-style recipe management system designed for developers and minimalist enthusiasts.

RE.cipe provides a clean, monospaced interface for organizing, filtering, and planning meals. It leverages a Terminal User Interface (TUI) aesthetic to provide a high-efficiency workspace for culinary notes and meal planning.

## Core Features

- **TUI Dashboard**: Terminal-inspired interface with ASCII art and customizable themes.
- **Recipe Management**: Create, edit, and organize recipes with detailed ingredients and cooking steps.
- **Terminal Aesthetics**: JetBrains Mono font, blinking cursors, and monospaced layout.
- **Meal Planning**: Structure your culinary workflow with a developer-centric perspective.
- **Privacy First**: Secure authentication and personal recipe storage.

## Key Pages

- [Landing Page](https://re-cipe.example.com/index.html): Project overview, features, and interactive terminal demo.
- [Authentication](https://re-cipe.example.com/auth.html): User login and registration portal.
- [Workspace](https://re-cipe.example.com/app.html): Main dashboard for managing your recipe collection.

## Technical Context

- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (No heavy frameworks).
- **Typography**: JetBrains Mono (Primary monospaced font).
- **Design Pattern**: Minimalist TUI (Terminal User Interface).
- **Target Audience**: Developers, SysAdmins, and Tech Enthusiasts.
